verdictEs: Mobalytics si quieres editorial opinionated con tier lists y planner integrado; Fextralife si quieres wiki factual con cobertura completa y community comments.
verdictEn: Mobalytics if you want opinionated editorial with tier lists and integrated planner; Fextralife if you want a factual wiki with complete coverage and community comments.

useCases.reasonEs: Mobalytics tiene tier lists editorial actualizadas por patch. Fextralife es factual sin opinion clara.
useCases.reasonEn: Mobalytics has per-patch updated editorial tier lists. Fextralife is factual without clear opinion.

useCases.labelEn: Factual lookup of a specific item
useCases.reasonEs: Fextralife tiene página por item con stats, location, drops. Mobalytics agrupa por priority, no por item.
useCases.reasonEn: Fextralife has per-item pages with stats, location, drops. Mobalytics groups by priority, not per item.

useCases.reasonEs: Fextralife tiene comments por página con community wisdom. Mobalytics no implementa comments.
useCases.reasonEn: Fextralife has per-page comments with community wisdom. Mobalytics doesn't implement comments.

useCases.reasonEs: Mobalytics tiene build planner integrado. Fextralife es solo wiki sin tools.
useCases.reasonEn: Mobalytics has integrated build planner. Fextralife is wiki-only without tools.

useCases.reasonEs: Mobalytics tiene apps mobile dedicadas. Fextralife mobile es ad-heavy y difícil de leer.
useCases.reasonEn: Mobalytics has dedicated mobile apps. Fextralife mobile is ad-heavy and hard to read.
